description: This file defines the ConnectCasesClient class for interacting with the Amazon Connect Cases service, including method signatures for various operations and their async counterparts.

classes.name: ConnectCasesClient
classes.description: A client class for Amazon Connect Cases service, extending AwsClient, with methods for case management operations.

methods.name: batchGetField
methods.description: Retrieves multiple fields in a batch operation.

methods.name: batchGetFieldAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves multiple fields in a batch operation.

methods.name: createCase
methods.description: Creates a new case in Amazon Connect Cases.

methods.name: getCase
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific case.

methods.name: listCasesForContact
methods.description: Lists cases associated with a contact.

methods.name: listCasesForContactAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously lists cases for a contact.
